config.no_folder: No folder for config.toml was found
feature.analyse.a1: Yes. Analyse works on any Game, whether you played it or opened it from a database.
feature.analyse.a2: Not while a rated game against a person is live online. It comes back when the game ends.
feature.analyse.q1: Can I analyse a game I did not play in Bragd?
feature.analyse.title: Analyse
feature.analyse.what: Step through a Game, try other moves, and let an Engine evaluate each position.
feature.databases.a1: No. Bragd reads a Foreign database in place, and only rewrites it when you choose Save.
feature.databases.a2: Two Games with the same moves from the same start are one Game in a Library, whatever their headers say. It remembers every Source it came from.
feature.databases.q1: Does opening a PGN file change it?
feature.databases.title: Databases
feature.databases.what: Open game files in their own formats, or import them into a Library where each Game appears once.
feature.engines.a1: Bragd uses an installed Engine first. Otherwise it can pull a sealed container image with podman or docker.
feature.engines.a2: Tafl, ur and senet have no outside Engine. They get Bragd's own built-in Bots.
feature.engines.q1: Do I have to install Stockfish?
feature.engines.q2: Why is there no Engine for tafl?
feature.engines.title: Engines
feature.engines.what: Programs that play and evaluate positions, found on this machine or run from a sealed container image.
feature.families.a1: Settings → Game families, or the install wizard. Each Family and each Variant has its own switch.
feature.families.a2: Nothing is deleted. Its files still open, with a banner offering to turn it back on.
feature.families.q1: Where do I turn a game off?
feature.families.q2: What happens to my games of a Family I turn off?
feature.families.title: Game families
feature.families.what: Chess, xiangqi, shogi, go, draughts, tafl, backgammon, ur and senet, with 25 Variants. Turn off what you do not play.
feature.helper.a1: It fetches Sources, indexes your Libraries and finds Duplicates, so the windows stay quick.
feature.helper.a2: Ten minutes after the last window closes, unless Start with my session is on.
feature.helper.title: The Helper
feature.helper.what: A background process shared by every Bragd window that fetches, indexes and finds Duplicates.
feature.play.a1: Yes: play against an Engine, against yourself on one board, or online.
feature.play.a2: Each Variant names its own Sides: White and Black, Red and Black, Sente and Gote, Attackers and Defenders.
feature.play.q1: Can I play both Sides myself?
feature.play.q2: Why are the Sides not called White and Black?
feature.play.title: Play
feature.play.what: Start a Game of any Variant that is on, against an Engine, against yourself or online.
feature.tablebases.a1: 3–5 pieces, about 1 GB, covers most endgames. 6 pieces is a large download; 7 pieces is a folder you bring yourself.
feature.tablebases.a2: Only when the tables you have do not cover a position, and only while Ask Lichess for tablebase positions is on.
feature.tablebases.q2: When does a position go to Lichess?
feature.tablebases.title: Tablebases
feature.tablebases.what: Perfect play for chess positions with few pieces, from Syzygy tables, passed to every engine.
feature.themes.a1: Racing green, Bragd's own, built on the colours of its icon.
feature.themes.a2: No. A Board theme never inverts with a dark Theme: the light squares stay the lighter ones.
feature.themes.q2: Does a dark Theme turn the board dark?
feature.themes.title: Temaer
feature.themes.what: Thirty built-in Themes, a Look laid over them, your own Themes in config.toml, and four Board themes.
feature.update.a1: Nej. Den fortæller dig det kun. Opdateringen overlades til den måde, du installerede den på, så din pakkehåndtering bestemmer.
feature.update.a2: Untick Check for a new version in Settings → Privacy and updates.
feature.update.q2: How do I turn the check off?
feature.update.title: Opdateringstjek
feature.update.what: At start and once a day, asks where Bragd was installed from whether a newer release exists, and names the command that upgrades your copy.
features.title: Funktioner og spørgsmål
help.title: Hjælp
hint.features: F1 lists every feature, with the questions people ask about it.
hint.sidebar: Click a Game family to see its items. The arrow at the bottom folds the sidebar away.
notice.config_refused: config.toml, [{area}]: {problem}. Those settings keep their defaults until it is mended.
notice.config_unreadable: config.toml could not be read: {problem}. Every setting keeps its default until it is mended.
notice.family_off: {family} is turned off. Its files still open, and none of its data is deleted.
setting.board_theme.hint: The four colours of every board: light square, dark square, highlight and marker. Match theme takes them from the Theme.
setting.check_updates.hint: When it starts, then once a day while it is open, Bragd asks where it was installed from for the newest version number. Nothing else is sent.
setting.engines_containers: Pull an Engine that is not installed
setting.engines_containers.hint: Runs it from a sealed container image with podman or docker, with no network. An image shows its size before it downloads.
setting.language.hint: Automatic follows your system's language, or the nearest one Bragd has.
setting.library.hint: Where your Libraries are kept. Empty: Bragd's data folder.
setting.look.hint: The shapes and chrome laid over the Theme's colours. Empty: the Theme's own.
setting.source_priority.hint: When Duplicates merge, a header conflict goes the way of the Source listed first.
setting.start_with_session.hint: The Helper keeps fetching and indexing while no window is open. Otherwise it stops ten minutes after the last window closes.
setting.tablebases_online.hint: When your tables do not cover a position, that position is sent to the Lichess tablebase API.
setting.tablebases_path.hint: Your Syzygy tables. The folder is passed to every engine.
setting.theme.hint: The app's colours, and with some Themes their own shapes. Racing green is the default.
settings.suggest_translation_hint: Åbner et nyt issue på GitHub i browseren med sproget og versionen udfyldt. Bragd sender ikke selv noget.
